scope: single-core same-host indirect-call hot-cache kernels; complete original v6 phase then separately shuffled fixed-layout phase

layout.allocation: single posix_memalign arena before dlopen; initialized and prefaulted before timing
layout.coverage: only lower-base phase 0 mod 4096 and its prescribed gap/order-derived upper phase; not every alignment or physical placement
layout.addresses: record full observed addresses and their mod64/mod4096 phases; do not require equal virtual addresses between processes or disable ASLR

order.controlled: mode sum/zero/copy, ascending declared lengths, original ordered arms, then gap/order; one complete shuffle with seed 20261119

proofs: reuse the exact libraries built in this same complete v6 phase; no new codegen profile or inherited old campaign timing
correctness: all original untimed offset checks, nonzero controls, independent timed checksums, copy-byte and outside-range canaries; layout metadata before dlopen and address stability in every measured batch
reruns: no selected-cell reruns or discarded samples; --validate-only is a separate non-timing driver functional check
machine_sharing: affinity is not exclusive CPU ownership
excluded_claims: cross-phase causal attribution without the full conditions
